body.prompt: Photoreal industrial-design studio render of one palm-sized camera, 57 x 39 x 33 mm, concept ENTROPY: light reaching a black hole. image[1] = exact block and layout, keep it: SMALL 16 mm lens ring right of centre (a quarter of the width), flash window upper left, shutter and recessed switch on top left over the grip, USB-C and microSD on the right side. Idea DOPPLER DISK: the matte black core is wrapped by a stack of thin horizontal lamellae, 1 mm plates with 1 mm gaps, like the layered edge-on disk in image[2], lopsided as Doppler beaming makes it. On the left, the side moving toward you, they are thick, crisp, bright white and bulge 3 mm out as a full-height grip; going right they thin, crowd and darken through light grey and graphite to black, four colour steps = redshift; the last fine black lines dive into the lens rim. image[3] = such fine ridges on a real product. image[4] = crisp sculpted black top plate carrying shutter and switch. image[5] = ribbed lens ring with red index. Lamella edges are grip ribs, gaps open into bottom vents; flash window and light-pipe dots between lamellae, plug cover on the left end, corner eyelet. Rich functional surface detail, printable PLA. One camera centred on pure white, 3/4 front view slightly from above, soft light, sharp. --no text, logos, letters, numbers, screen, hands, strap, extra lenses, big lens barrel, screws
